in_marathi.name: Harshit
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Radiant, Glowing, Prosperous
in_marathi.long_meaning: Harshit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Harish (God Hari) + Tej (Fire, Glory) = Harshit. This name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Harish' and 'Tej', which mean 'God Hari' and 'Fire, Glory' respectively. The name Harshit represents the radiant and glowing nature of the divine being Hari, and signifies prosperity and good fortune.
